data/extracted/*/*_BIFVARINFO_YY_*.csv (one file per site, resolved via fluxnet::flux_discover_files())
notes: TowerTango card table. card_year_established via compute_site_year_presence() on monthly FLUXMET; card_sink_strength_nep_gC_m2_yr/card_et_* via compute_site_annual_fluxes() (VUT with CUT fallback, QC_THRESHOLD_YY=0.5); card_tower_height_m/_date/_variable and card_instrument_model from the structured VAR_INFO_HEIGHT field in each site's YY-resolution BIFVARINFO file (NEE_VUT_REF, else NEE_CUT_REF, else USTAR, latest VAR_INFO_DATE -- see README.md), replacing the earlier FLUX_MEASUREMENTS_COMMENT free-text regex guess; card_canopy_height_max_m/_date/_n_records from the structured HEIGHTC BADM field (GRP_HEIGHTC/HEIGHTC, plus JP-Shn's own non-standard VARIABLE_GROUP value -- see README.md), maximum value across ALL of a site's dated records as recorded in BADM (no HEIGHTC_STATISTIC filter -- a filter was added, then removed again, both on 2026-10-13, see SESSION_LOG.md); card_height_check flags (never excludes or alters) sites with a canopy height above 60 m, of 0 m, greater than card_tower_height_m, or an instrument height that changed over the record (with the range), blank when nothing is flagged; card_map_mm_yr/card_mat_degC from site_worldclim.csv with a local-raster fallback for any site missing from it.
